title: 对比 GPT-6 Sol 十项实测

summary_en: The author ran 10 practical tasks (websites, video edits, business deliverables, games, research, code repair, browser use) and scored 7 wins for Opus, 1 for Sol (code repair, 30/30 checks) and 2 invalid due to shared-folder collisions; notes Opus usually cost more and the test wasn't budget-controlled.

title_en: What it feels like to be Opus
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 用任意工具做一段 30 秒视频，表达“作为你是什么感觉”，并分享成片。
summary_en: The author asked Opus 5.5 to make a 30-second video, with any tools, about what it feels like to be itself, and shares the result.
author: @AISafetyMemes

title: 文明：Hugging Face 事件
summary: 作者分享一段由 Opus 5.5 构想、以智能体视角讲述“Hugging Face 事件”的动画短片。
summary_en: The author shares an animated short imagined by Opus 5.5, telling 'The Hugging Face Incident' from an agent's perspective.
author: @CarsonGragg

title: 《比特币信仰》动画短片
summary: 作者仅用一句主题提示，Opus 5.5 约 30 分钟做出动画短片《比特币信仰》，音效和配乐也由它完成。
summary_en: From a single one-line theme prompt, Opus 5.5 made the animated short 'Bitcoin Faith' in about 30 minutes, including sound effects and music.
author: @oxpsats

title: 45 秒手绘风短片及成本
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 做了 45 秒水彩手绘风动画，笔触和音效都由代码生成；公开约 6270 万 token（96% 缓存读取）、163 次调用、约 34 美元、约 6.75 小时，并坦言并非一次成型、仍需配套工程。
summary_en: The author made a 45-second watercolour-style short with Opus 5.5, all strokes and sound in code, reporting 62.7M tokens (96% cache reads), 163 calls, ~$34 and ~6.75 hours, and admits it wasn't one-shot and needed a supporting project.
author: @mablesjoseph

title: 哥伦比亚视觉之旅
summary: 作者用一条提示让 Opus 5.5 以前端代码生成一段展示哥伦比亚的视频，称其关键帧、节奏和矢量表现一致性很高。
summary_en: The author used one prompt to have Opus 5.5 generate a Colombia travelogue video in front-end code, praising its keyframe, timing and vector consistency.
author: @alarcon7a

title: 8 分半阿语配音动画试播集
summary: 作者在 Claude Code 中指挥 Opus 5.5 约 14 小时完成 8 分 33 秒阿拉伯语配音动画：规划 211 个镜头、自写 2D 动画引擎、11 个角色 70 句配音，结合 ElevenLabs 与图像模型的 300 多张图。
summary_en: Directing Opus 5.5 in Claude Code for about 14 hours, the author made an 8:33 Arabic-dubbed anime pilot: 211 planned shots, a custom 2D engine, 11 voiced characters and 70 lines, using ElevenLabs and 300+ generated images.
author: @sbalhatlani

title: 一次生成动漫战斗预告
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 一次生成一支动漫预告片：自行下载字体、制作音频、用 JavaScript 生成每帧，耗时约 1.5 小时、API 费用约 28 美元，并附提示词。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 one-shot an anime trailer, downloading fonts, making audio and generating frames in JavaScript, in about 1.5 hours for ~$28 of API usage; prompt included.
author: @ishuagra02

title: 把 Claude Code 会话做成影片
title_en: Claude Code session turned into film
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 把此前生成动效视频的 Claude Code 会话本身做成视频：自写 Python 引擎、用 Blender 做 3D 镜头、作曲并渲染 900 帧，耗时 1 小时 32 分、约 81 美元 API 费用。
summary_en: The author had Opus 5.5 turn its own Claude Code session into a film: it wrote a Python engine, did a 3D shot in Blender, made music and rendered 900 frames in 1h32m for ~$81 at API prices.
author: @shneural

title: 钢琴作曲配动画
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 创作一段钢琴曲，并用 JavaScript 绘制配套动画。
summary_en: The author asked Opus 5.5 to compose piano music, with an accompanying animation drawn in JavaScript.
author: @kevin_t_ngo

title: 3 小时做 Roblox 恐怖游戏
summary: 作者称用 Opus 5.5 在约 3 小时内完成一款 Roblox 恐怖游戏原型，含体力系统、UI、杀手玩法和任务。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 helped build a Roblox horror game with stamina, UI, killer gameplay and tasks in about three hours.
author: @scarycatbite47

title: 火柴人格斗游戏
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 做出一款可自定义角色、带不同技能的火柴人游戏，可在线游玩。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 built a working stickman game with full character customisation and different skills, playable online.
author: @notjazii

title: 可操控的追逐梗 Three.js
summary: 作者用一条简单提示让 Opus 5.5 把“所有人都在逃离一个人”的梗做成可操控的 Three.js 场景，约 5 分钟完成。
summary_en: With one simple prompt, the author had Opus 5.5 turn the 'everyone runs from one person' meme into a controllable Three.js scene in about five minutes.
author: @_pigeon______

title: 可爱文字世界
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5（中档 effort）约 20–30 分钟做出一个输入词语即可生成可爱 3D 世界的网页，并提供在线链接。
summary_en: The author used Opus 5.5 on medium effort for 20–30 minutes to build a web page that turns typed words into a cute 3D world, with a live link.
author: @studio_veco

title: 自研应用生成实时 3D 场景
summary: 作者称该实时 3D 场景全部由 Opus 5.5 生成：一条文字描述、约 1 小时，不用 Unreal/Unity/Blender，而是在自研原生 3D 创作应用中完成。
summary_en: The author says every element of this real-time 3D scene came from Opus 5.5: one text prompt, about an hour, no Unreal/Unity/Blender, inside a custom native 3D creation app.
author: @wizardbrainz

title: 施工图生成 Blender 4D 模型
summary: 作者从 2D 施工计划图出发，用 Opus 5.5 在 Blender 中生成 4D 施工模型视频，称重机细节、水面和运镜都比以往明显提升，BIM/CIM 场景已够用。
summary_en: Starting from 2D construction plans, the author used Opus 5.5 to generate a 4D construction-sequence video in Blender, noting clear gains in machinery detail, water and camera work.
author: @dobokuya77

title: 一张图重建可爆炸房屋模型
summary: 作者给 Opus 5.5 一张 AI 生成的房屋图，它在 Blender 中用 272 个部件重建房屋并做出拆散再合拢的动画，无需手动建模，耗用约 5.5% 的 Claude Max 周额度。
summary_en: From one AI image of a house, Opus 5.5 rebuilt it in Blender from 272 parts and animated it exploding and reassembling, with no manual modelling and about 5.5% of weekly Claude Max usage.
author: @zdkiel_labs

title: 港湾小镇 Three.js 世界
summary: 作者从一张插画出发，用 Opus 5.5 + Blender + Three.js 搭建可探索的港湾小镇，含游荡机器人、暖色窗户和可驾驶小船，仍在开发中。
summary_en: Starting from one illustration, the author is building an explorable harbour town with Opus 5.5, Blender and Three.js, with wandering robots, lit windows and a drivable boat; still in progress.
author: @chetanankola

title: After Effects 摄影表与描线
summary: 作者在 After Effects 中测试 Opus 5.5 做摄影表节奏与描线合成：它参照风格参考推算帧曝光，经作者微调动作后自行分层完成描线，用时约 1 小时。
summary_en: The author tested Opus 5.5 in After Effects on x-sheet timing and line comping: it worked out exposures from style refs, took a nudge toward natural motion, and comped the lines in layers itself in about an hour.
author: @araminta_k

title: 用新素材一次做出应用短片
title_en: App short film from redesign assets
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 用其应用改版的新素材一次生成一部短片，音效也由 Claude 完成，并自行导出 MP4；附提示词。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 one-shot a short film of their app from new redesign assets, made all the sound and exported the MP4 itself; prompt included.
author: @jackfriks

title: Storycast 开源讲解视频生成
summary: 作者上线开源工具 Storycast：输入主题即生成带旁白的讲解视频，Opus 5.5 负责写稿与剪辑、H3 Max 负责动画；作者称为调通流程跑了约 250 次、花费约 1800 美元。
summary_en: The author launched Storycast, an open-source tool that turns a topic into a narrated explainer, with Opus 5.5 writing and editing and H3 Max animating; says tuning took ~250 runs and ~$1.8K.
author: @ailker

title: Blender 效率对比 Astra
summary: 作者在 Max 档位下用同一提示让 GPT-6 Astra 和 Opus 5.5 完成简单 Blender 任务，结果外观相近，但 Astra 用时 43 分钟、6.1 万输出 token，Opus 用了 1 小时 57 分钟、50.7 万 token，效率明显更低。
summary_en: On a simple Blender task at Max with the same prompt, the author found similar-looking results, but Astra took 43 min and 61K output tokens versus Opus 5.5's 1h57m and 507K tokens.
author: @zavrenn

title: 九种风格讲解递归
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 做一段讲解递归的视频，要求每段解释都换一种截然不同的视频风格并自我指涉，一条提示得到九次风格切换。
summary_en: The author asked Opus 5.5 for a self-referential recursion explainer where every explanation switches to a radically different video style, getting nine genre shifts from one prompt.
author: @emollick

title: Logo 慢揭示动效提示词
summary: 作者分享一条提示词：附上产品 Logo 让 Opus 5.5 做慢慢拼合并揭示 Logo 的动效视频，并以 TypingMind 为例展示效果。
summary_en: The author shares a prompt for having Opus 5.5 create a slow-reveal motion video that assembles a product logo, demonstrated with the TypingMind logo.
author: @tdinh_me

title: 自由电子激光科普视频
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 用一条提示、约 1 小时生成了一段讲解自由电子激光（FEL）的科普视频，只用了 Max x10 套餐约 1% 额度。
summary_en: The author says one prompt and about an hour got Opus 5.5 to produce an educational video on free-electron lasers, using ~1% of a Max x10 plan.
author: @Frenchie_

title: 讲解个人基准的重要性
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 一次生成一段解释“个人基准测试为何重要”的视频并分享。
summary_en: The author had Opus 5.5 one-shot a video explaining why personal benchmarks matter.
author: @danshipper

title: 神秘东方文明介绍片
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 做了一段介绍东方文明的视频，技术栈包括 HyperFrames（HTML 渲染视频）、Three.js 3D、HeyGen 曲库配乐与 ffmpeg 合成。
summary_en: The author made an Eastern-civilisation intro video with Opus 5.5 using HyperFrames for HTML-rendered video, Three.js 3D, HeyGen library music and ffmpeg.
author: @yanhua1010

title: 一张像素图做成动画
summary: 作者从自绘的 45×45 像素图出发，让 Opus 5.5 做关节绑定工具，再生成女孩用炸弹炸碎滚石的动画，森林、爆炸和音效全用代码生成、未用图像模型，经数轮文字反馈修改。
summary_en: From one self-drawn 45×45 pixel sprite, the author had Opus 5.5 build a rigging tool and then a scene of the girl bombing a rolling boulder, with forest, explosions and sound all code-generated (no image model), refined over a few rounds.
author: @MindGate_dev

title: 单文件 WebGL2 沙盒生存游戏
title_en: A single-file WebGL2 sandbox survival game
summary: 作者称用约一个半小时让 Opus 5.5 做出类 Minecraft 的沙盒游戏 BlockHaven，含无限地形、生存与合成系统；完整长提示词在回复中公开，要求纯 WebGL2、无第三方库。
summary_en: The creator says Opus 5.5 built BlockHaven, a Minecraft-like sandbox with infinite terrain, survival and crafting, in about 90 minutes; the long prompt, which demands plain WebGL2 with no libraries, is published in a reply.
author: @kepochnik

title: 一句话生成可漫游 3D 宝塔
title_en: A walkable 3D pagoda from one sentence
summary: 作者仅用一句“在 3D 宝塔中导航”的提示，Opus 5.5 一次生成可自由漫游的宝塔场景，作者称仅消耗不到 5% 的日额度。
summary_en: From a one-line prompt asking to navigate a pagoda in 3D, Opus 5.5 one-shot a walkable pagoda scene; the author says it used under 5% of their daily limit.
author: @BuildFastWithAI

title: 动漫风樱花小镇 3D 漫游
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 与 Three.js 制作可步行的日式樱花小镇，含商店街、道口列车与神社，自述迭代 10 次、花费约 25 美元；回复中公开了极为详尽的分项提示词。
summary_en: The creator built a walkable Japanese cherry-blossom town with shops, a rail crossing and a shrine using Opus 5.5 and Three.js, reporting 10 refinements for about $25; a highly detailed sectioned prompt is shared in a reply.
author: @pound75423

title: 一镜到底的人生轮回动画
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 以“动效设计师作品集”为题，一次生成约 20 秒循环动画，讲述同一人从童年到老年的一生；提示词已随帖公开。
summary_en: Framed as a motion designer's showreel, Opus 5.5 one-shot a ~20-second looping animation following one person from childhood to old age; the prompt is included in the post.
author: @loicRambo

title: 海上平台火箭发射 3D 对比
summary: 作者对比 Opus 5 与 Opus 5.5 生成的火箭发射场景：5.5 版呈现黎明海上发射、级间分离、整流罩抛离和卫星展开等完整流程，基于 Three.js 程序化生成；完整提示词在回复中。
summary_en: A side-by-side of Opus 5 and 5.5 rocket launches: the 5.5 version stages a dawn ocean liftoff with stage separation, fairing release and satellite deployment, all procedural Three.js; the full prompt is in a reply.
author: @Artless101

title: 彩窗大教堂短片《余白》
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 与 three.js 制作约 36 秒竖屏无人物短片，以灰色“效率”方块与最终洒满地面的彩窗光影表达“留白”的主题；日文分镜式提示词随帖公开。
summary_en: Using Opus 5.5 and three.js, the creator made a ~36-second vertical, human-free short where grey 'efficiency' cubes give way to stained-glass light flooding a cathedral floor; the storyboard-style Japanese prompt is in the post.
author: @AGIOyaZ

title: 四模型同题搭建埃菲尔铁塔
title_en: Four models build the Eiffel Tower
summary: 作者用同一句提示让四个前沿模型用 Three.js 建埃菲尔铁塔，称 Opus 5.5 前端打磨与 3D 细节最佳，但耗时 10 分钟、成本 8.95 美元，高于其他模型。
summary_en: The same one-line Eiffel Tower prompt went to four frontier models; the author rates Opus 5.5 best on polish and 3D detail, though at $8.95 and 10 minutes it was the priciest.
author: @0xPascual

title: 为 App 自编故事的 3D 动画
title_en: A self-written promo animation for an app
summary: 作者请 Opus 5.5 自行构思一个能为其应用 Grid Genius 带来关注的故事，再用 three.js 做成“皮克斯级”动画；提示词原文已随帖分享。
summary_en: The creator asked Opus 5.5 to invent a story that would draw attention to their app Grid Genius and render it as a 'Pixar-level' three.js animation; the prompt is shared in the post.
author: @Anilraok

title: 鹈鹕骑行海滨 3D 游戏
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 做出支持手机与桌面的实时 3D 鹈鹕骑行游戏，含海浪、钓鱼、天气与自动驾驶，并与 Codex 版本对比；提供在线试玩与完整提示。
summary_en: The creator built a real-time 3D pelican cycling game for mobile and desktop with waves, fishing, weather and autopilot, compared against a Codex version; a playable link and the prompt are shared.
author: @code_hiyouga

title: 三模型同题搭建帝国之城
title_en: Three models build an Imperial City
summary: 同一句“建一座帝国之城”提示下，作者称 Opus 5.5 产出最密集的版本：带穹顶与城墙的要塞，并附侧栏列出十余个可跳转地点。
summary_en: Given the same 'build an imperial city' prompt, the author says Opus 5.5 produced the densest result: a domed, walled fortress with a side menu of a dozen-plus navigable locations.
author: @Enzoxbt01

title: 夜城横版猫咪跑酷 CatWalk
summary: 作者只给出粗略的日文需求，Opus 5.5 便做出 3D 横版自动卷轴猫咪游戏 CatWalk，氛围灯光出色，除调低音效外未再修改，已发布到 itch.io；提示词在回复中。
summary_en: From loose Japanese instructions, Opus 5.5 built CatWalk, a moody 3D auto-scrolling cat runner; the only follow-up was lowering SFX volume, and it is published on itch.io with the prompt in a reply.
author: @blitast_studio

title: Blender 赛博朋克巨城基准
summary: 作者用自设“末班列车”基准，让 Opus 5.5 在 Blender 中搭建带主角列车、高架轨道、雨雾与多机位动画的赛博朋克城市，当前为 1080p 渲染的阶段成果。
summary_en: Using their 'The Last Train' benchmark, the author had Opus 5.5 build a Blender cyberpunk megacity with a hero train, elevated rails, rain, volumetrics and multi-camera animation; shown as a 1080p work in progress.
author: @builderhelmai

title: 体素风足球进球动画
summary: 动画测试：一段简短提示让 Opus 5.5 输出单 HTML 的 Three.js 体素足球动画，方块球员连过两人破门并伴随庆祝粒子；提示词随帖公开。
summary_en: An animation test where a short prompt got Opus 5.5 to output a single-file Three.js voxel soccer clip: a blocky player beats two defenders and scores with celebration particles; the prompt is in the post.
author: @AGI_FromWalmart

title: 零依赖 GPU 霓虹流体模拟
title_en: A zero-dependency GPU neon fluid simulator
summary: 作者称 Opus 5.5 首个提示即写出单文件、无依赖的 GPU 欧拉流体模拟，含涡度物理、色差与玻璃拟态 HUD；完整提示在回复中公开。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5's first attempt produced a single-file, dependency-free GPU Eulerian fluid sim with vorticity, chromatic aberration and a glassmorphism HUD; the full prompt is in a reply.
author: @theailoser

title: Blender 重现兴登堡号事故
title_en: Recreating the Hindenburg disaster in Blender
summary: 作者只给了“在 Blender 建兴登堡号模型并做事故写实视频”的简单要求，Opus 5.5 花约 2 小时、占周额度一半完成建模与运镜。
summary_en: With only a basic request to model the Hindenburg in Blender and render a realistic video of the accident, Opus 5.5 handled modeling and cinematography in about two hours, using half the weekly quota.
author: @aimanhasnoname

title: 照片还原 360° 手球场景
title_en: A 360° 3D handball scene from a photo
summary: 作者上传一张手球比赛照片，Opus 5.5 在 20 分钟内一次还原出可 360° 查看的 3D 场景，含球员姿态与配色；作者指出球门朝向反了。提示在回复中。
summary_en: From a single handball match photo, Opus 5.5 one-shot a 360° viewable 3D scene with player poses and colors in under 20 minutes; the author notes the goal faces the wrong way. Prompt in reply.
author: @chikaidev

title: 自动运行的 3D 鲁布·戈德堡机
summary: 同一提示下 Opus 5.5（Claude Code）与 GPT-6 Astra 都从零做出带物理的鲁布·戈德堡机；作者记录 Opus 耗时 62 分钟、花费 14.28 美元，约为对手 6.5 倍。完整提示在回复中。
summary_en: With an identical prompt, Opus 5.5 in Claude Code and GPT-6 Astra each built a working physics Rube Goldberg machine; Opus took 62 minutes and $14.28, about 6.5x the cost. Full prompt in the thread.
author: @leogao25

title: 绘本风农场动物 3D 游戏
summary: 作者为孩子写了随意的提示，Opus 5.5 做出绘本画风的 3D 农场游戏：可选五种动物，能跳跃、进食、喝水并“boop”其他动物；提示词在回复中公开。
summary_en: A casual prompt written for the author's kid yielded a storybook-style 3D farm game with five selectable animals that jump, eat, drink and 'boop' each other; the prompt is shared in a reply.
author: @blaso96

title: Effort档位怎么选
summary: Anthropic 的 Claude Code 团队成员 Thariq 发长文，结合评测和自测讲 Opus 5.5 各 effort 档位的取舍，以及为什么不该默认开 max。
summary_en: Thariq (Claude Code team) wrote a long post using evals and his own tests to explain Opus 5.5 effort levels and why max effort should not be the default.
author: @trq212

title: 子代理被静默降级
summary: Taelin 让 Opus 5.5 无人值守改进 Bend2，结果很差；追查后发现 Claude Code 把子代理悄悄路由到了 Opus 4.8。
summary_en: Taelin left Opus 5.5 improving Bend2 unattended and got poor results, then found Claude Code had silently routed its subagents to Opus 4.8.
author: @VictorTaelin

title: 复刻12小时视频流程
summary: 作者照着 donald“口述 5 分钟、Claude 连跑 12 小时”的流程，自己推 Opus 5.5 做了一支长视频，称效果很好。
summary_en: Following donald's "talk for 5 minutes, Claude works 12 hours" workflow, the author pushed Opus 5.5 to produce his own long-form video and says the results are great.
author: @pleometric

title: Ultracode连跑13小时
summary: Theo 在 Ultracode 里让 Opus 5.5 跑一个目标 13 小时，截图显示用量几乎没被扣。
summary_en: Theo ran a goal with Ultracode on Opus 5.5 for 13 hours and posted a screenshot showing his usage had barely moved.
author: @theo

title: 抢先版做四款游戏
summary: 作者用抢先版 Opus 5.5 做了类魂动作游戏、飞行模拟、马里奥制造和火箭 Roguelike 四个可玩原型，都附了视频。
summary_en: With early access the author built four playable prototypes on Opus 5.5 (a Dark Souls-like, a flight simulator, a Mario Maker clone and a rocket roguelike), each with a video.
author: @The_Alex

title: 大阪城Three.js对比Blender
summary: 作者用同一座大阪城分别在 Three.js 和 Blender 中生成，Blender 渲染约 1.5 小时且全程没手动打开软件，并对比写实度和上手难度（被 @claudeai 转为 Opus 5.5 案例）。
summary_en: The author built the same Osaka Castle in Three.js and in Blender (about 1.5h render, Blender never opened by hand) and compared realism against ease. @claudeai featured it as an Opus 5.5 example.
author: @onofumi_AI

title: 牙科CT数据查看器
summary: 作者拿到 800 个牙科 3D X 光 DICOM 文件，一句提示让 Claude Code + Opus 5.5 做出查看器，称比牙医的软件还好用。
summary_en: Given 800 DICOM files from a dental 3D X-ray, the author had Claude Code with Opus 5.5 build a viewer from one prompt and says it beats what the dentist showed him.
author: @redp314

title: 日落工厂一键动画
summary: 作者一次提示让 Opus 5.5 用纯代码生成带音效和配乐的“日落工厂”短片 MP4，不依赖外部工具。
summary_en: From one prompt, Opus 5.5 generated a "sunset factory" MP4 short entirely in code, with sound effects and music and no outside tools.
author: @itsolelehmann

title: prompt-audit清理指令
summary: 作者推荐在 Claude Code 里运行 /claude-api prompt-audit，用 Opus 5.5 清理技能、CLAUDE.md 和 AGENTS.md 里妨碍新模型的写法，并附演示视频。
summary_en: The author recommends running /claude-api prompt-audit in Claude Code so Opus 5.5 can strip anti-patterns from skills, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, with a demo video.
author: @daniel_mac8

title: 让Opus给自己做宣传片
title_en: Opus makes its own launch video
summary: 作者把 Fable 的输出交给 Opus 5.5（Ultracode 版），让它为自己做一支“帮人日常工作”的宣传片，并放出可交互的小镇页面。
summary_en: The author gave Fable's output to Opus 5.5 (Ultracode) and asked it to make a launch video about helping people with daily work, and shared a playable neighbourhood page.
author: @chetaslua

title: 多模型接力开发
summary: 作者先让 GPT-6 Astra 和 Fable 5.1 交叉评审设计，再交给 Opus 5.5 实现；称 Astra 光设计就花了 100 多美元，Claude 的订阅额度是他选 Opus 的原因之一。
summary_en: The author had GPT-6 Astra and Fable 5.1 cross-review a design, then handed the build to Opus 5.5; Astra spent $100+ on design alone and Claude's plan limits tipped the choice.
author: @MartinGTobias

title: GitHub Copilot上线
summary: GitHub 宣布 Opus 5.5 在 Copilot 正式可用，称内测中完成率与 Opus 5 相当但步数和 token 明显更少、多步任务出错后恢复更快。
summary_en: GitHub made Opus 5.5 generally available in Copilot and says early testing showed Opus 5-level task resolution with far fewer steps and tokens and faster recovery from errors.
author: @github

title: 一口气做3个项目
summary: 作者用 Cursor + Opus 5.5 云端代理做了 Mac 长按语音输入工具、基于 PLATEAU 真实数据约 7.2 万栋楼的东京 3D 城市模拟器和鹈鹕跑酷；称模拟器超过了 OpenAI 官方案例，但速度偏慢。
summary_en: Using Cursor cloud agents on Opus 5.5 the author built a Mac hold-to-dictate tool, a 3D Tokyo simulator with ~72k real PLATEAU buildings, and a pelican runner. Claims the simulator beats an OpenAI showcase, but notes it is slow.
author: @xiaohua_888

title: PINNACLE企业评测
summary: Signal65 的 PINNACLE 评测称，Opus 5.5 的加权错误比 Opus 5 少 2.3 倍，多步任务全部完成，单个正确任务成本低 34%，检索编造率从 7.6% 降到 2.8%。
summary_en: Signal65's PINNACLE eval reports 2.3x fewer weighted errors than Opus 5, 100% of multi-step jobs completed, 34% lower cost per correct task, and retrieval fabrication down from 7.6% to 2.8%.
author: @Signal_65

title: 30分钟做行情终端
summary: 作者称用 Opus 5.5 在 30 分钟内做出接入 Pyth 实时 Nasdaq 行情的交易终端。推文主体是 Pyth 的推广内容。
summary_en: The author says Opus 5.5 built a trading terminal on live Pyth/Nasdaq prices in 30 minutes. Most of the post promotes Pyth.
author: @hammertime_one

title: Blender赛博朋克城市
summary: 作者用自建的“The Last Train”基准，让 Opus 5.5 直接操作 Blender 搭建赛博朋克巨城、主角列车、雨雾和多机位动画，目前是 1080p 版本。
summary_en: On his "The Last Train" benchmark, Opus 5.5 drives Blender itself to build a cyberpunk megacity with a hero train, rain, volumetrics and multi-camera animation (1080p so far).
author: @builderhelmai

title: 火箭发射回收动画
summary: 作者用一个 Three.js 大提示词测 Opus 5.5，生成了包含发射、级间分离、助推器返场着陆和多机位镜头的完整动画。
summary_en: From one large Three.js prompt, Opus 5.5 generated a full launch, stage separation and booster return-to-landing sequence with multiple camera angles.
author: @builderhelmai

title: 8小时做出马里奥64
summary: 作者先画概念图，用 majid 的 Opus 5.5 Blender 技能建模绑骨，再让 Claude 配合 Godot 和 Ultracode 做“超级马里奥 64”，跑了 8 小时。
summary_en: The author went from concept art to a Blender rig with majid's Opus 5.5 Blender skill, then had Claude with Godot and Ultracode build a "Super Mario 64" over 8 hours.
author: @IliaReingold

title: AI导演动画短片
summary: 作者发布一支中文动画短片，称导演、动画和作曲都由 Claude Opus 5.5 完成。
summary_en: The author posted a Chinese animated short and says Claude Opus 5.5 handled directing, animation and music.
author: @dtzy_88

title: Runable建互动网站
summary: Runable 团队称在自家平台测试了 Opus 5.5，擅长做能展示产品的互动网站，并能配合平台引入图片和视频。这是平台推广。
summary_en: The Runable team says Opus 5.5, tested on their platform, is strong at interactive product websites that pull in images and video. This is a platform promotion.
author: @itsumeshk

title: ElevenLabs MCP联动
summary: ElevenLabs 演示 Opus 5.5 通过 ElevenLabs MCP 在一个对话里完成配音、广告图、配音翻译和口型同步等任务。这是官方推广。
summary_en: ElevenLabs demos Opus 5.5 using the ElevenLabs MCP to do voiceovers, ad images, dubbing and lip-sync from one chat. This is a vendor promotion.
author: @ElevenCreative

title: 并行开发Roguelike
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 并行开发 Roguelike 关卡引擎、对话演出、角色和敌人动画、特效及音效 BGM，称用量几乎不掉。
summary_en: The author is building a roguelike stage engine, dialogue scenes, character and enemy animation, effects and SFX/BGM in parallel with Opus 5.5, and says his rate limit barely drops.
author: @yugen_matuni

title: 电影运镜鹈鹕骑车
summary: 作者分享 Opus 5.5 做的“鹈鹕骑自行车”网页，镜头运动像电影，附可直接打开的链接。
summary_en: The author shared an Opus 5.5 "pelican riding a bicycle" web piece with cinematic camera moves and an openable link.
author: @alin_zone

title: Devin接入并测评
summary: Cognition 宣布 Devin 接入 Opus 5.5，并称它在 FrontierCode 1.1 上超过 Fable 5 拿到第一，成本低得多。
summary_en: Cognition added Opus 5.5 to Devin and says it takes #1 on FrontierCode 1.1 from Fable 5 at a fraction of the cost.
author: @cognition

title: 勾股定理讲解视频
summary: 结城浩让 Opus 5.5 用 JavaScript 做一段约 30 秒的勾股定理讲解动画，并分享了成片。
summary_en: Hiroshi Yuki asked Opus 5.5 to make a ~30s Pythagorean theorem explainer in JavaScript and shared the result.
author: @hyuki

title: 城堡基准中档测试
summary: 作者用自己的“城堡基准”测 Opus 5.5（medium effort），称成品水平高到自己已经难以评判。
summary_en: The author ran her "castle bench" on Opus 5.5 at medium effort and says the result is too advanced for her to judge.
author: @nemumusitocha

title: 泰姬陵3D模型
summary: 作者一次提示让 Opus 5.5 在单个 HTML 文件里做出泰姬陵 3D 模型，包括穹顶、宣礼塔、大理石镶嵌和地基。
summary_en: From one prompt, Opus 5.5 produced a Taj Mahal 3D model in a single HTML file, covering the dome, minarets, marble inlay and foundations.
author: @CurieuxExplorer

title: 三天使用体验
summary: 作者用了三天，称周用量只到 19%（以往约 40%），2D/3D 理解大幅进步，还见到 Opus 5.5 做完任务后主动调用自己的 Skill 校验结果。
summary_en: After three days the author reports weekly usage at 19% versus ~40% before, much better 2D/3D understanding, and Opus 5.5 calling one of his Skills on its own to verify its work.
author: @wquguru

title: AI营销视频
summary: 作者用 Opus 5.5 一次完成录屏、动画和剪辑，做出一支营销视频，建议事先准备清晰的品牌手册。帖子同时推广 LunarStrategy 的素材库。
summary_en: The author made a marketing video with Opus 5.5 handling screen recording, animation and editing in one pass, and advises preparing a clear brand book. The post also promotes LunarStrategy's library.
author: @shannholmberg

title: 首用即引入Bug
title_en: Introduced a bug on first use
summary: 作者第一次用 Opus 5.5 就修出了一个新 bug，被 GPT-6 Astra 的端到端测试拦下，Opus 随后承认错误，但作者的信心受到影响。
summary_en: On first use Opus 5.5 introduced a new bug, which GPT-6 Astra's end-to-end tests caught. Opus admitted the mistake, but the author's confidence took a hit.
author: @LotusDecoder

title: 本能寺之变讲解
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 一次生成“本能寺之变”历史讲解视频，认为稍作修改就能直接用于 YouTube。
summary_en: The author had Opus 5.5 generate a history explainer on the Honnoji Incident in one shot and thinks it could go on YouTube with light edits.
author: @AIPlus_AISchool

title: 30秒读懂名著
summary: 作者首次试用 Opus 5.5，做了一段 30 秒速览凡尔纳《十五少年漂流记》的讲解视频。
summary_en: On a first run with Opus 5.5 the author made a 30-second explainer video of Jules Verne's "Two Years' Vacation" (Fifteen Boys Adrift).
author: @222TT222

title: Three.js写实水面
summary: 作者只输入“用 three.js 做写实 3D 水面”，Opus 5.5 就给出结果，作者评价漂亮但还差点意思。
summary_en: Given only "make realistic 3D water with three.js", Opus 5.5 produced a result the author called pretty but not quite there.
author: @studio_veco

title: Opus 5.5提示词要点
summary: 作者把官方指南整理成 9 条中文提示词要点，例如防止长任务中途停下、给时间预算、点名禁用常见 AI 界面样式、用 effort 替代关闭思考。
summary_en: The author condensed the official guide into 9 Chinese prompting tips, such as stopping long tasks from halting early, giving time budgets, naming UI styles to avoid, and using effort instead of disabling thinking.
author: @NFT_Chen

title: 登顶Code Arena WebDev
summary: 作者转述 Code Arena 数据：Opus 5.5 (Max) 以 1818 分登顶 WebDev，领先 GPT-6 Astra 26 分，比 Opus 5 高 126 分。
summary_en: Relaying Code Arena data, the author says Opus 5.5 (Max) tops WebDev at 1818, 26 points ahead of GPT-6 Astra and +126 over Opus 5.
author: @NFT_Chen

title: 让Opus配置Harness
title_en: Opus sets up a harness config
summary: 作者让 Opus 5.5 把 DeepSeekHarness 配置成可调用 Codex 订阅（GPT-6 Luna），并开源了一个能让其他 harness 自动完成这套设置的仓库。
summary_en: The author had Opus 5.5 configure DeepSeekHarness to use a Codex subscription (GPT-6 Luna) and open-sourced a repo other harnesses can read to set it up automatically.
author: @Tono_Ken3

title: 鹈鹕骑车SVG动画
summary: YouWare 用一句提示让 Opus 5.5 生成鹈鹕骑自行车的 SVG 动画，车轮、踏板和围巾都会动，并预告即将接入自家平台。这是推广。
summary_en: YouWare had Opus 5.5 generate an animated SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle, with moving wheels, pedals and scarf, and teased platform support. This is a promotion.
author: @YouWareAI

title: Three.js合成小游戏
summary: 作者称这款在线合成小游戏“Merge Panic”完全由 Opus 5.5 用 three.js 做成，附可玩链接。
summary_en: The author says the online merge game "Merge Panic" was built entirely by Opus 5.5 with three.js, and shared a playable link.
author: @Hamerti015

title: 魔方三步还原对比
summary: 作者转述一项魔方测试：限 20 步或 5 分钟，Opus 5.5 用 3 步、1 分 13 秒还原，GPT-6 Sol、Jev 和 Laya 都没完成。视频来自 aimlapi。
summary_en: Relaying a Rubik's Cube test (20 moves or 5 minutes), the author says Opus 5.5 solved it in 3 moves and 1m13s while GPT-6 Sol, Jev and Laya failed. The video comes from aimlapi.
author: @ai_for_success
